thread:
erin: heads up — noticed a TTFT spike on /api/generate for rdx-7b-q4 around 20:10 UTC, median up ~60% vs baseline. traces show kernel time up but decode contribution doesn't explain it. anyone digging?
ben: saw the alert, pulling traces now. first-pass looks like matmul/op kernels spiking more than usual.
carmen: what was the batch/microbatch mix? seq lengths? those change kernel selection heuristics.
dave: querying token traces to get a kernel breakdown, posting query so we can reproduce locally:
```
SELECT route, model, token_idx, kernel_name, SUM(kernel_ms) AS kernel_ms
FROM token_traces
WHERE route='/api/generate' AND model='rdx-7b-q4' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY route, model, token_idx, kernel_name
ORDER BY kernel_ms DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
frank: FYI sampling was 1% for token traces to control cardinality. I'll bump to 5% for 30m to get better signal (will annotate sampling windows).
perfbot: instrumentation: token-timers v0.9 -> now emitting kernel_name + kernel_variant tags (canary rollout).
gpu-bot: correlating with device metrics — L2 cache miss rate increased on those hosts during the window. matmul time up correlates with higher cache churn.
carmen: ok that smells like a microkernel code-path change + allocator alignment. Also KV prefetch patterns can push different memory access patterns into matmul. we should tag traces with kv_prefetch boolean.
ben: proposal: add these extra metadata fields in token trace: kernel_variant, kv_prefetch, microbatch_size, seq_len. that will let us slice per-route KPIs.
dave: I can add dashboard panels: TTFT waterfall by token (prequeue | queue | kernel-init | kernel-exec | kvcache | postproc), kernel split donut, and per-route SLA heatmap. any preferred histogram buckets?
erin: make buckets 0-5ms,5-15,15-40,40-100,100+ for kernel exec. include med/95/99. share link when ready.
frank: increased sample now. side note — we saw a small perf PR yesterday that adjusted workspace alignment on the allocator; dunno if it landed to canary.
ben: I'll grep the changelog and the runtime build tags for that PR. if it's the culprit we can revert the allocator tweak on canary nodes.
carmen: until we confirm, add a dashboard filter for kernel_variant so ops can quickly toggle between old/new microkernel.
dave: dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz123/ttft-token-waterfall?orgId=1&var-model=rdx-7b-q4&from=now-1h (will push to eng-runtime folder).
erin: thanks. if the 5% sample shows persistent matmul cost we should schedule a microkernel revert canary and run exact same workload. calling an action item: ben to validate PRs, frank to watch host perf, dave to publish dashboard, carmen to add kv_prefetch tagging.
ben: on it.
frank: watching alerts, will post host traces. :thumbsup:
perfbot: deploy note — token-timers canary rolled to 5% of runtime nodes at 21:02 UTC, instrumentation flags set.
